# pairwise log fold
## ture topic =2 for k =6, 9, 15, 30
```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(MASS)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Distance and error utilities
# ----------------------------------------------------------
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1*v2) /
                 (sqrt(sum(v1^2)*sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k,j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(
    mean_error = mean(diffs),
    max_error  = max(diffs)
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# FIXED mapping: K → number of DE topics
# --------------------------------------------------
K_values <- c(6, 9, 15, 30)
diff_map <- c(`6`=2, `9`=2, `15`=2, `30`=2)

nsim <- 20

# separate containers for BH and BY
all_results_BH5 <- list()
all_results_BY5 <- list()
row_BH <- 1
row_BY <- 1

set.seed(999)

# =====================================================
#                  MAIN SIMULATION LOOP
# =====================================================
for (K in K_values) {

  n_diff <- diff_map[as.character(K)]
  cat("\n=========================================\n")
  cat("Running K =", K, "| n_diff =", n_diff, "\n")
  cat("=========================================\n")

  for (sim in 1:nsim) {

    N <- 1000; G <- 500
    beta_strength <- 2
    set.seed(100 + sim)

    # Condition
    X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

    # True latent effects
    mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)

    diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
    diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
    diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

    beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean=beta_strength, sd=0.5), 0)

    # Logits and topic intensities
    eta <- sapply(1:K, function(k)
      rnorm(N, mu_k[k] + X*beta_k[k], 1)
    )
    E <- exp(eta)

    # True W (topic–gene)
    T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K*G, 0, 1), K, G)
    W_true <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) rdirichlet(1, a)))

    # Counts
    l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
    mean_ng <- (E %*% W_true) * l_n
    Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N*G, lambda=as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Fit fastTopics and get θ (topic proportions) & β
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k=K, numiter=200, verbose="none")
    fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)
    theta_hat <- fit_multinom$L    # N × K
    beta_hat  <- fit_multinom$F    # G × K

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Alignment step (Hungarian on W_true vs β)
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
    assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)

    beta_hat_aligned  <- beta_hat[, assignment]   # G × K
    theta_hat_aligned <- theta_hat[, assignment]  # N × K

    W_est_aligned <- t(beta_hat_aligned)          # K × G

    # Topic estimation error (W_true ≈ W_est_aligned)
    err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

    # ====================================================
    #  Pairwise log-ratio limma on θ (PAIR-LEVEL METRICS)
    # ====================================================
    eps <- 1e-8

    # All unordered topic pairs (k < l), total = choose(K, 2)
    pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))    # each row: (k, l)
    n_pairs  <- nrow(pair_mat)

    # N × n_pairs matrix of log-ratios per cell
    log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=N, ncol=n_pairs)

    for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
      k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
      k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
      log_ratio_mat[, p] <-
        log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) -
        log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)
    }

    colnames(log_ratio_mat) <-
      apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2]))

    # Build design for limma
    design <- model.matrix(~ X)

    # limma expects features × samples
    LR_for_limma <- t(log_ratio_mat)   # n_pairs × N

    fitL <- lmFit(LR_for_limma, design)
    fitL <- eBayes(fitL)

    # p-values for the condition effect (2nd coefficient)
    pvals_pairs <- fitL$p.value[, 2]

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Pair-level TRUTH: pair is DE iff exactly ONE topic is DE
    # (DE vs non-DE = alternative, DE vs DE = null, nonDE vs nonDE = null)
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    pair_truth <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
      k1 <- idx[1]; k2 <- idx[2]
      diff_k[k1] != diff_k[k2]    # xor
    })

    # =========================
    #  BH-adjusted metrics
    # =========================
    qvals_BH <- p.adjust(pvals_pairs, method = "BH")
    detected_BH_pairs <- qvals_BH < 0.05

    TP_BH <- sum(detected_BH_pairs & pair_truth)
    FP_BH <- sum(detected_BH_pairs & !pair_truth)

    Power_BH <- TP_BH / sum(pair_truth)
    FDP_BH   <- ifelse(sum(detected_BH_pairs) == 0, 0, FP_BH / sum(detected_BH_pairs))

    all_results_BH5[[row_BH]] <- data.frame(
      Adjust = "BH",
      K = K,
      n_diff = n_diff,
      sim = sim,
      TP_pairs = TP_BH,
      FP_pairs = FP_BH,
      Power_pairs = Power_BH,
      FDP_pairs = FDP_BH,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error
    )
    row_BH <- row_BH + 1

    # =========================
    #  BY-adjusted metrics
    # =========================
    qvals_BY <- p.adjust(pvals_pairs, method = "BY")
    detected_BY_pairs <- qvals_BY < 0.05

    TP_BY <- sum(detected_BY_pairs & pair_truth)
    FP_BY <- sum(detected_BY_pairs & !pair_truth)

    Power_BY <- TP_BY / sum(pair_truth)
    FDP_BY   <- ifelse(sum(detected_BY_pairs) == 0, 0, FP_BY / sum(detected_BY_pairs))

    all_results_BY5[[row_BY]] <- data.frame(
      Adjust = "BY",
      K = K,
      n_diff = n_diff,
      sim = sim,
      TP_pairs = TP_BY,
      FP_pairs = FP_BY,
      Power_pairs = Power_BY,
      FDP_pairs = FDP_BY,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error
    )
    row_BY <- row_BY + 1
  }
}

output_BH5 <- do.call(rbind, all_results_BH5)
output_BY5 <- do.call(rbind, all_results_BY5)

output_BH5
output_BY5
```

```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(MASS)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Distance and error utilities
# ----------------------------------------------------------
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1*v2) /
                 (sqrt(sum(v1^2)*sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k,j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(
    mean_error = mean(diffs),
    max_error  = max(diffs)
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# FIXED mapping: K → number of DE topics
# --------------------------------------------------
K_values <- c(6, 9, 15, 30)
diff_map <- c(`6`=2, `9`=3, `15`=5, `30`=10)

nsim <- 20

all_results5 <- list()
row_id <- 1

set.seed(999)

# =====================================================
#                  MAIN SIMULATION LOOP
# =====================================================
for (K in K_values) {

  n_diff <- diff_map[as.character(K)]
  cat("\n=========================================\n")
  cat("Running K =", K, "| n_diff =", n_diff, "\n")
  cat("=========================================\n")

  for (sim in 1:nsim) {

    N <- 1000; G <- 500
    beta_strength <- 2
    set.seed(100 + sim)

    # Condition
    X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

    # True latent effects
    mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)

    diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
    diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
    diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

    beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean=beta_strength, sd=0.5), 0)

    # Logits and topic intensities
    eta <- sapply(1:K, function(k)
      rnorm(N, mu_k[k] + X*beta_k[k], 1)
    )
    E <- exp(eta)

    # True W (topic–gene)
    T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K*G, 0, 1), K, G)
    W_true <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) rdirichlet(1, a)))

    # Counts
    l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
    mean_ng <- (E %*% W_true) * l_n
    Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N*G, lambda=as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Fit fastTopics and get θ (topic proportions) & β
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k=K, numiter=200, verbose="none")
    fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)
    theta_hat <- fit_multinom$L    # N × K
    beta_hat  <- fit_multinom$F    # G × K

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Alignment step (Hungarian on W_true vs β)
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
    assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)

    beta_hat_aligned  <- beta_hat[, assignment]   # G × K
    theta_hat_aligned <- theta_hat[, assignment]  # N × K

    W_est_aligned <- t(beta_hat_aligned)          # K × G

    # Topic estimation error (W_true ≈ W_est_aligned)
    err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

    # ====================================================
    #  Pairwise log-ratio limma on θ (PAIR-LEVEL METRICS)
    # ====================================================
    eps <- 1e-8

    # All unordered topic pairs (k < l), total = choose(K, 2)
    pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))    # each row: (k, l)
    n_pairs  <- nrow(pair_mat)

    # N × n_pairs matrix of log-ratios per cell
    log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=N, ncol=n_pairs)

    for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
      k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
      k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
      log_ratio_mat[, p] <-
        log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) -
        log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)
    }

    colnames(log_ratio_mat) <-
      apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2]))

    # Build design for limma
    design <- model.matrix(~ X)

    # limma expects features × samples
    LR_for_limma <- t(log_ratio_mat)   # n_pairs × N

    fitL <- lmFit(LR_for_limma, design)
    fitL <- eBayes(fitL)

    # p-values for the condition effect (2nd coefficient)
    pvals_pairs <- fitL$p.value[, 2]
    qvals_pairs <- p.adjust(pvals_pairs, method="BH")

    detected_pairs <- qvals_pairs < 0.05

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Pair-level TRUTH: a pair is DE if at least one topic is DE
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # pair_truth <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
    #   k1 <- idx[1]; k2 <- idx[2]
    #   diff_k[k1] | diff_k[k2]
    # })
    pair_truth <- apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) {
      k1 <- idx[1]; k2 <- idx[2]
      diff_k[k1] != diff_k[k2]      # TRUE iff exactly one is DE
    })



    # Pair-level metrics
    TP_pair <- sum(detected_pairs & pair_truth)
    FP_pair <- sum(detected_pairs & !pair_truth)

    Power_pair <- TP_pair / sum(pair_truth)
    FDP_pair   <- ifelse(sum(detected_pairs) == 0, 0, FP_pair / sum(detected_pairs))

    all_results5[[row_id]] <- data.frame(
      K = K,
      n_diff = n_diff,
      sim = sim,
      TP_pairs = TP_pair,
      FP_pairs = FP_pair,
      Power_pairs = Power_pair,
      FDP_pairs = FDP_pair,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error
    )
    row_id <- row_id + 1
  }
}

output5 <- do.call(rbind, all_results5)
```

```{r}
library(MCMCpack)
library(MASS)
library(fastTopics)
library(limma)
library(clue)

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Distance and error utilities
# ----------------------------------------------------------
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1*v2) /
                 (sqrt(sum(v1^2)*sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k,j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(
    mean_error = mean(diffs),
    max_error  = max(diffs)
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# FIXED mapping: K → number of DE topics
# --------------------------------------------------
# K_values <- c(6, 9, 15, 30)
K_values <- c(6)
diff_map <- c(`6`=2, `9`=3, `15`=5, `30`=10)

nsim <- 1   # adjust if needed

all_results5 <- list()
row_id <- 1

set.seed(999)

# =====================================================
#                  MAIN SIMULATION LOOP
# =====================================================
for (K in K_values) {

  n_diff <- diff_map[as.character(K)]
  cat("\n=========================================\n")
  cat("Running K =", K, "| n_diff =", n_diff, "\n")
  cat("=========================================\n")

  for (sim in 1:nsim) {

    N <- 1000; G <- 500
    beta_strength <- 2
    set.seed(100 + sim)

    # Condition
    X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

    # True latent effects
    mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)

    diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
    diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
    diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

    beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean=beta_strength, sd=0.5), 0)

    # Logits and topic intensities
    eta <- sapply(1:K, function(k)
      rnorm(N, mu_k[k] + X*beta_k[k], 1)
    )
    E <- exp(eta)

    # True W (topic–gene)
    T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K*G, 0, 1), K, G)
    W_true <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) rdirichlet(1, a)))

    # Counts
    l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
    mean_ng <- (E %*% W_true) * l_n
    Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N*G, lambda=as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Fit fastTopics and get θ (topic proportions) & β
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k=K, numiter=200, verbose="none")
    fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)
    theta_hat <- fit_multinom$L    # N × K
    beta_hat  <- fit_multinom$F    # G × K

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Alignment step (Hungarian on W_true vs β)
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
    assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)

    beta_hat_aligned  <- beta_hat[, assignment]   # G × K
    theta_hat_aligned <- theta_hat[, assignment]  # N × K

    W_est_aligned <- t(beta_hat_aligned)          # K × G

    # Topic estimation error (W_true ≈ W_est_aligned)
    err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

    # ====================================================
    #  NEW: Pairwise log-ratio limma on θ
    # ====================================================
    eps <- 1e-8

    # All unordered topic pairs (k < l)
    pair_mat <- t(combn(K, 2))    # each row: (k, l)
    n_pairs  <- nrow(pair_mat)

    # N × n_pairs matrix of log-ratios per cell
    log_ratio_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=N, ncol=n_pairs)

    for (p in 1:n_pairs) {
      k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
      k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
      log_ratio_mat[, p] <-
        log(theta_hat_aligned[, k1] + eps) -
        log(theta_hat_aligned[, k2] + eps)
    }

    colnames(log_ratio_mat) <-
      apply(pair_mat, 1, function(idx) paste0("T", idx[1], "_vs_T", idx[2]))

    # Build design for limma
    design <- model.matrix(~ X)

    # limma expects features × samples
    LR_for_limma <- t(log_ratio_mat)   # n_pairs × N

    fitL <- lmFit(LR_for_limma, design)
    fitL <- eBayes(fitL)

    # p-values for the condition effect (2nd coefficient)
    pvals_pairs <- fitL$p.value[, 2]
    qvals_pairs <- p.adjust(pvals_pairs, method="BH")

    detected_pairs <- qvals_pairs < 0.05

    # Map pair-level detections back to topic-level detections:
    # A topic is "detected" if any pair involving it is detected.
    detected_topics <- rep(FALSE, K)
    for (p in which(detected_pairs)) {
      k1 <- pair_mat[p, 1]
      k2 <- pair_mat[p, 2]
      detected_topics[c(k1, k2)] <- TRUE
    }

    # ----------------------------------------------------
    # Topic-level Power & FDP (as before)
    # ----------------------------------------------------
    TP  <- sum(detected_topics & diff_k)
    FP  <- sum(detected_topics & !diff_k)

    Power <- TP / n_diff
    FDP   <- ifelse(sum(detected_topics) == 0, 0, FP / sum(detected_topics))

    all_results5[[row_id]] <- data.frame(
      K = K,
      n_diff = n_diff,
      sim = sim,
      TP = TP,
      FP = FP,
      Power = Power,
      FDP = FDP,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error
    )
    row_id <- row_id + 1
  }
}

output5 <- do.call(rbind, all_results5)
output5
```

```{r}
compute_distance_matrix <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  K <- nrow(W_true)
  D <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    for (j in 1:K) {
      v1 <- W_true[k, ]
      v2 <- W_est[j, ]
      cos_sim <- sum(v1*v2) /
                 (sqrt(sum(v1^2)*sum(v2^2)) + 1e-20)
      D[k,j] <- 1 - cos_sim
    }
  }
  D
}

compute_topic_error <- function(W_true, W_est) {
  diffs <- sqrt(rowSums((W_true - W_est)^2))
  list(
    mean_error = mean(diffs),
    max_error  = max(diffs)
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# FIXED mapping: K → number of DE topics
# --------------------------------------------------
K_values <- c(6, 9, 15, 30)
diff_map <- c(`6`=2, `9`=3, `15`=5, `30`=10)

nsim <- 20   # adjust if needed

all_results1 <- list()
row_id <- 1

set.seed(999)

# =====================================================
#                  MAIN SIMULATION LOOP
# =====================================================
for (K in K_values) {

  n_diff <- diff_map[as.character(K)]
  cat("\n=========================================\n")
  cat("Running K =", K, "| n_diff =", n_diff, "\n")
  cat("=========================================\n")

  for (sim in 1:nsim) {

    N <- 1000; G <- 500
    beta_strength <- 2
    set.seed(100 + sim)

    # Condition
    X <- rbinom(N, 1, 0.5)

    # True latent effects
    mu_k <- rnorm(K, 0, 1)

    diff_k <- rep(FALSE, K)
    diff_idx <- sample(1:K, n_diff)
    diff_k[diff_idx] <- TRUE

    beta_k <- ifelse(diff_k, rnorm(K, mean=beta_strength, sd=0.5), 0)

    # Logits and topic intensities
    eta <- sapply(1:K, function(k)
      rnorm(N, mu_k[k] + X*beta_k[k], 1)
    )
    E <- exp(eta)

    # True W
    T_mat <- matrix(rlnorm(K*G, 0, 1), K, G)
    W_true <- t(apply(T_mat, 1, function(a) rdirichlet(1, a)))

    # Counts
    l_n <- runif(N, 1000, 10000)
    mean_ng <- (E %*% W_true) * l_n
    Y_ng <- matrix(rpois(N*G, lambda=as.vector(mean_ng)), N, G)

    # Fit fastTopics
    fit <- fit_poisson_nmf(Y_ng, k=K, numiter=200, verbose="none")
    fit_multinom <- poisson2multinom(fit)
    beta_hat  <- fit_multinom$F

    # ---------------------------------------------
    # Alignment step
    # ---------------------------------------------
    D <- compute_distance_matrix(W_true, t(beta_hat))
    assignment <- solve_LSAP(D)
    beta_hat <- beta_hat[, assignment]
    W_est_aligned <- t(beta_hat)

    # Topic estimation error
    err <- compute_topic_error(W_true, W_est_aligned)

    # ---------------------------------------------
    # Per-cell Poisson GLM to recover activity
    # ---------------------------------------------
    W_est <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=N, ncol=K)
    for (ii in 1:N) {
      y_i <- Y_ng[ii, ]
      X_i <- l_n[ii] * beta_hat

      df_i <- data.frame(y=y_i, X_i)
      colnames(df_i) <- c("y", paste0("B",1:K))

      form_i <- as.formula(
        paste("y ~", paste(colnames(df_i)[-1], collapse=" + "), "- 1")
      )

      fit_i <- try(
        glm(form_i, data=df_i, family=poisson(link="identity"),
            start=rep(mean(y_i)/K, K)),
        silent=TRUE
      )

      coef_i <- if (inherits(fit_i, "try-error")) rep(0,K) else coef(fit_i)
      W_est[ii,] <- pmax(coef_i, 0)
    }

    # limma test
    W_log <- log(W_est + 1e-8)
    fitL <- lmFit(t(W_log), model.matrix(~ X))
    fitL <- eBayes(fitL)
    tt <- topTable(fitL, coef=2, number=Inf, sort.by="none")
    detected <- p.adjust(tt$P.Value, "BH") < 0.05

    # Metrics
    TP  <- sum(detected & diff_k)
    FP  <- sum(detected & !diff_k)
    Power <- TP / n_diff
    FDP   <- ifelse(sum(detected)==0, 0, FP / sum(detected))

    all_results1[[row_id]] <- data.frame(
      K = K,
      n_diff = n_diff,
      sim = sim,
      TP = TP,
      FP = FP,
      Power = Power,
      FDP = FDP,
      mean_err = err$mean_error,
      max_err  = err$max_error
    )
    row_id <- row_id + 1
  }
}

output1 <- do.call(rbind, all_results1)
output1
```
